title: Add typed decision view and confirmed supersession list to backtest
summary: Build §8 step 2 of decision-sets.md: a typed read-only view of D01–D90 built from docs/decisions.md and the supersession/amend parse, checked against a committed user-confirmed list that includes D11 amended_by D39 (line 322). `athena backtest` condition (a) then compares its hits to that list instead of the hard-coded two pairs. No briefs, defaults, or decisions.md prose change.

defaults_applied.how: New view and list check get unit tests; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change: the view, the list, and the backtest wiring.
Reuse existing serde and toml dependencies and the existing parser rather than a new crate.
Doc comments and the design doc update are written for an outside reader.
Replace the hard-coded expected pairs that caused the D11 finding with a confirmed list, rather than adding one more special case.
Behavior verified by running cargo test on the real decisions.md.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Step 2 means all D01–D90 get a derived view (id, status, superseded_by, amended_by) only; kind, phase, paths, enforcement are not assigned per entry, since §6 step 2's per-entry judgement is a separate job.

The confirmed list is a committed data file read at runtime (docs/decision-links.toml) or an equivalent embedded constant; I could not read records/ so I rely on the 24 hits reported in §9 and the grep of decisions.md.

Per §6 step 3, D11 and every partial revision is amended_by; only wholly replaced decisions are superseded. D46/D79 is treated as full per its text, unless the producer finds otherwise, and I do not decide other 'Amends' extents beyond the log's wording.
'Condition (a) passes on the real log' means the parse/list check; conditions (b)-(d) depend on records/ and may still fail, and that is out of scope.
The 'user-confirmed' list is built from the parse and shown in the change for the user to confirm; the only hit the user has explicitly confirmed is D11/D39.

acceptance_criteria.text: A typed decision view exists in athena-cli: one record per entry heading of docs/decisions.md with id, status (active/superseded), superseded_by and amended_by derived from the parse plus the confirmed list; the log's prose is untouched.

A committed confirmed list names every supersession and amend hit with its line, older id, newer id, and confirmed status; it includes D11 amended_by D39 at line 322 (status stays active) and D46→D79 and D87→D88 (D87 amended_by, not superseded), and prose-only hits from D48 on.

The backtest's condition (a) compares parsed hits with the confirmed list (hits missing from the list or listed but not found are findings) and no longer uses the hard-coded EXPECTED_SUPERSESSIONS pair list.
No brief, defaults.toml, BRIEF.md, or docs/decisions.md prose is modified; no governance file is changed.
decision-sets.md §8 step 2 is marked built and says what the confirmed list is; CHANGELOG notes the change.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`: new tests pass, including one that parses the repo's docs/decisions.md and finds no condition (a) finding, one that D11 is active with amended_by D39, and one that an unlisted hit is reported.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Changing any brief or set selection (step 3)
Editing docs/decisions.md prose or adding headers to it
Host-error record, watcher, Jev, defaults.toml or DefaultsModel changes
Fixing backtest conditions (b)-(d) or D87's signal
Assigning kind, phase, enforcement per entry
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference: it adds a new module, a data file, and design-doc edits, and ambiguity about the confirmed list's form lowers acceptance odds a little.
